turns.instruction:
Spatial frame with a missing top-floor transverse beam

Reconstruct from the drawing and execute YJK. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first. Report the following signed results with units and cases/combinations; include consistent model/result figures:
- Global Uy of the laterally loaded top corner n2-1-2
- Global Uy of n1-1-2, the back endpoint of the missing beam
- Global Uy of n1-0-2, the front endpoint of the missing beam
- Signed relative Uy across the missing beam: Uy(n1-1-2) minus Uy(n1-0-2)
